mapper.select:
SELECT MAX(permission) FROM (
SELECT permission FROM dept_privilege WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND is_del = 1 AND biz_type = 1 AND target_id = #{kbId} AND permission > 0 UNION
SELECT permission FROM group_privilege gp LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON gp.group_id = ug.group_id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} AND gp.is_del = 1 AND biz_type = 1 AND target_id = #{kbId} AND permission > 0 UNION
UNION SELECT permission FROM user_privilege WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_del = 1 AND biz_type = 1 AND target_id = #{kbId} AND permission > 0 UNION SELECT permission FROM user_privilege WHERE user_id = -1 AND is_del = 1 AND biz_type=1 AND target_id=#{kbId} AND permission > 0 UNION SELECT 3 FROM knowledge_base WHERE create_by=#{userName} AND id = #{kbId}) t1
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base SET config = CAST( REPLACE(JSON_UNQUOTE(config), #{sourceModelName}, #{targetModelName}) AS JSON ) WHERE status = 1 AND JSON_SEARCH(config, 'one', #{sourceModelName}) IS NOT NULL;
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_name, primitive_name, platform FROM knowledge_base WHERE status = 1 AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config, CONCAT('$.', #{modelTypeName}))) = #{modelName}
